explication: msgvault is a local-first communications archive. The principal workflow is: a person uses the CLI, browser, TUI, HTTP API, or MCP; sources are synced or imported; messages, files, meetings, and contacts are persisted; identities and derived indexes are maintained; queries, people views, exports, or backups return results. The tree and README establish the major capabilities, while sampled source confirms API-driven search, semantic indexing, and identity-review flows. Several internal call edges remain intentionally conservative.
